representation.tensor: Trident.get_trident_seg: clip_features = model.clip.encode_image(...) (recorded by hook), L2-normalised
representation.model: open_clip ViT-H-14 laion2b_s32b_b79k with Trident DINO/SAM correlation refinement (official Cityscapes config)
representation.classifier: logits = f . query_features^T (mean-templated CLIP text embeddings, unit norm); official coarse probs = softmax(40 * bilinear(logits))
representation.relation_to_cached_probs: cached 25-class vectors = SAM-refined per-view probabilities (refinement rewrites region scores after this classifier)

teacher.hook: model.clip.encode_image output, L2-normalised (the tensor the official code projects onto text)

lifting.resampling: token grid -> native (bilinear) -> LingBot lattice (bilinear, align_corners=False), as the official logits are resampled
lifting.correspondence: identical (voxel, frame) pairs and weights as the probability-path evidence cache (checked per anchor)

fusion.F: f_AB = normalize(w_A f_A + w_B f_B); p'_AB = softmax(40 f_AB . text)

controls.C2: within (anchor, z band 4 vox, xy cell 20 vox)
controls.C3: within Trident class across the drive

env.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q Workstation Edition
